facts.business: Easy Trip Planners Limited (EaseMyTrip) is a travel-tech platform offering a one-stop travel ecosystem spanning flights, hotels, holidays, mobility, cruises, visa assistance and ancillary travel services.

segments.name: Ancillary Value-added Services (Travel Insurance, Visa Processing, Tickets for Activities & Attractions, Flight Check-In, Travel Guides)

guidance_or_targets.statement: Vision 2030 aspirations: driving sustainable growth, expanding global reach and creating enduring value for customers, partners and shareholders.
guidance_or_targets.value: sustainable growth, global reach, enduring value

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matter: Recoverability of investments in and loans given to subsidiaries (investments aggregating to Rs 916.70 million and loans aggregating to Rs 1060.70 million as at 31 March 2026).

key_risks: Recoverability of investments in and loans given to subsidiaries
Impairment indicators for investments in subsidiaries (Ind AS 36)
Significant increase in credit risk for loans to subsidiaries (Ind AS 109)
facts.related_party_note: Investments in and loans given to subsidiary companies aggregating to Rs 916.70 million and Rs 1060.70 million respectively as at 31 March 2026.
